{{Short description|Type of fiber bundle on a Riemann surface}}
In mathematics, an '''indigenous bundle''' on a [[Riemann surface]] is a [[fiber bundle]] with a [[flat connection]] associated to some [[complex projective structure]]. Indigenous bundles were introduced by {{harvs|txt|last=Gunning|first=Robert C.|authorlink=Robert C. Gunning|year=1967}}.  Indigenous bundles for curves over [[p-adic field]]s were introduced by {{harvs|txt|last=Mochizuki|first=Shinichi | authorlink=Shinichi Mochizuki|year=1996}} in his study of [[p-adic Teichmüller theory]].
